sourceTaskTitle: Resolve service demand and execution eligibility
stopCriterion: Apply frozen recovered CR1–CR11: decompose only on explicit source-supported information/gate/action/evidence contracts; fail closed on unresolved client binding; stop when terminal semantics are sufficient without undocumented operational knowledge.

workUnits.name: Resolve service demand and execution eligibility
workUnits.purpose: Determine whether governed Road LTL demand is eligible and create/reject the service request with traceable evidence.
workUnits.trigger: Approved order, replenishment demand or service request exists.

workUnits.name: Resolve required request information
workUnits.purpose: Resolve the governed information required before eligibility evaluation.

workUnits.name: Evaluate eligibility gates
workUnits.purpose: Apply the explicit completeness, serviceability, conditions and time-window eligibility controls.

workUnits.name: Commit eligibility outcome and evidence
workUnits.purpose: Apply the governed action after gate evaluation and retain required execution evidence.

workUnits.name: Resolve transport service request
workUnits.purpose: Validate unique request identity, current version and authenticated requester.
atomicActions: Resolve the transport service request as the governed object on which eligibility is decided; verify unique identity, current version and requester authentication.
evidenceRequirements: CR10 authority materiality: NOT_MATERIAL — this is deterministic information resolution and does not exercise service eligibility or override authority.
workUnits.outputState: Governed transport service request is resolved for eligibility evaluation.

workUnits.name: Resolve shipper and consignee parties
workUnits.purpose: Resolve shipper/consignee identities to authoritative party master records.
atomicActions: Resolve shipper and consignee party identities to authoritative party master records.
evidenceRequirements: CR10 authority materiality: NOT_MATERIAL — this resolves party identity only; it does not decide service eligibility or contractual authority.

workUnits.name: Resolve origin and destination locations
workUnits.purpose: Resolve origin/destination to authoritative location master and geography.
atomicActions: Resolve origin and destination locations to authoritative location master/geography.
evidenceRequirements: CR10 authority materiality: NOT_MATERIAL — this resolves governed places and does not exercise serviceability decision authority.

workUnits.name: Resolve cargo profile
workUnits.purpose: Resolve description, package/handling-unit count, weight/dimensions where required, and special conditions.
atomicActions: Resolve cargo profile from transaction evidence including description, handling/package counts, weight/dimensions where required and special conditions.
evidenceRequirements: CR10 authority materiality: NOT_MATERIAL — this resolves cargo facts only; prohibited/special-condition eligibility is evaluated later by a governed gate.
workUnits.outputState: Cargo profile is resolved for eligibility evaluation.

workUnits.name: Resolve commodity/freight classification context
workUnits.purpose: Resolve the applicable commodity/freight classification reference under the governing scheme/version when required.

blockingReasons: RequiredInformation LTL-01::REQ::05 explicitly marks clientBindingRequired=true; the applicable commercial/regulatory classification scheme/version is context-dependent.

workUnits.name: Resolve allowed service and lane serviceability context
workUnits.purpose: Resolve the effective-dated service catalogue/lane matrix applicable to the request.

blockingReasons: Actual service catalogue/lane matrix is client/carrier network master data.

workUnits.name: Resolve booking/pickup cut-off policy
workUnits.purpose: Resolve the timezone-aware effective booking/pickup cut-off policy for time-sensitive requested service dates.

blockingReasons: Actual cut-off values and scope are client/carrier parameters or contract values.

workUnits.name: Resolve commercial contract/service entitlement context
workUnits.purpose: Resolve the active/effective contract, tariff or commercial entitlement applicable to the account/lane/service/date.

blockingReasons: Actual contract/service entitlements are client/carrier commercial bindings.

workUnits.name: Evaluate request completeness
workUnits.purpose: Check whether required parties, locations, cargo profile and requested service/date exist before eligibility evaluation.
decisionGates: PASS when required parties, locations, cargo profile and requested service/date exist; FAIL routes to request correction/HOLD_OR_EXCEPTION.
branchTransitions: FAIL → request correction / HOLD_OR_EXCEPTION; route observed variance to LTL-14.
evidenceRequirements: CR10 authority materiality: NOT_MATERIAL — the source gives the deterministic completeness condition; no discretionary service-owner authority is required to evaluate presence/absence.

workUnits.name: Evaluate lane/service serviceability
workUnits.purpose: Determine whether requested lane and service are supported by the active service matrix.

blockingReasons: Decision rule is canonical, but the active client/carrier service matrix is unresolved.

workUnits.name: Evaluate prohibited/special-condition eligibility
workUnits.purpose: Determine whether prohibited/restricted commodity and special-condition prerequisites are satisfied under active policy/contract context.

blockingReasons: Canonical condition gate is explicit, but active prohibited/restricted policy, contract entitlement and where applicable classification scheme/context require binding.

workUnits.name: Evaluate requested date against validity/cut-off
workUnits.purpose: Determine whether quote/request validity and applicable pickup cut-off permit the requested service date/window.

blockingReasons: Clock semantics are known, but actual cut-off parameter/value and scope are client/carrier binding.

workUnits.name: Resolve controlled override authority
workUnits.purpose: Resolve the client role/team and delegated limits permitted to override governed eligibility controls when override is invoked.

blockingReasons: Canonical authority basis is contracted service owner with controlled override authority, but actual client role/team/delegated limits are unresolved.

workUnits.name: Create or reject transport service request with reason
workUnits.purpose: Commit the governed eligibility outcome to the transport service request when applicable gate results permit the action.
workUnits.trigger: Applicable decision gate permits the state-changing action.
atomicActions: Create or reject the transport service request with reason in the canonical authority system role.
evidenceRequirements: Eligibility result, rule/policy version, request timestamp and rejection/override record as applicable.

CR10 authority materiality: MATERIAL_AND_RESOLVED — source names performer role, Contracted service owner/controlled override authority, authority object obj-transport-service-request, and authority system sys-tms; runtime executor identity is not required.

workUnits.name: Capture eligibility execution evidence
workUnits.purpose: Retain the eligibility result, governing rule/policy version, request timestamp and rejection/override evidence linked to the request.
workUnits.trigger: Eligibility evaluation reaches a governed outcome or hold/exception.
atomicActions: Capture the required execution evidence and link it to the service request/business object.
evidenceRequirements: CR10 authority materiality: NOT_MATERIAL — this records already-produced governed evidence and does not decide eligibility, precedence or override approval.
workUnits.outputState: Eligibility evidence is identifiable, attributable and linked to the service request.

nonBlockingKnownGaps.driveRuleBaselineMirror: PENDING_DOC_BODY_WRITE_DUE_GOOGLE_DOCS_WRITE_QUOTA; GitHub frozen rule baseline remains authoritative.
